reason: I already paid for vidIQ and it didn't move my views, so a tool that says it will coach me on my channel needs to show me something real before I hand over money. Hindi support is a good sign, but a label on the same kind of tool doesn't change whether it works.
objection: That Mitra just repackages the numbers I can already see in YouTube Studio and gives generic advice on titles and thumbnails, and I won't know whether it helped until months later.
would_change_my_mind: A free-credit result that names a specific video of mine, beats my usual views, and explains why in Hindi or Hinglish in a way I can check against my own analytics.
